t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Shape of the gnomes does not matter. Basket colour can align to the gnome colour. Where 1x points this can be used to indicate the basket which will collect more mushrooms.3+ mushrooms is a good collection basket. Advisor states to keep collecting the same basket colour until the mushrooms drop below 3

vb_textbox.text: Ignore the 2 different gnome shapes it does not matter.Where 1 point is shown the following basket colour is likely to collect many mushrooms.If there is a red basket which collects 3 or more mushrooms, select a red, purple or pink gnome next. If there is a yellow basket which collects 3 or more mushrooms, select a yellow, purple or orange gnome next. This is likely to gain more mushrooms. Note, once the basket falls below 3 mushrooms switch to the other basket type
